parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description: The page number. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. The default value is 20.

parameters.name: StatusList
parameters.description: A list of relationship statuses. The value is an enumeration of RelationshipStatusEnum. If you do not specify this parameter, only relationships that are in effect are queried.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account.
